parsed.explanation: Multiple traveler-facing exposures, none criminalizing identity. Worst features are tier-1: state-backed single-sex facility rules with no documented remedy; birth-sex custody placement with a documented sexual assault and judicial dismissal of claims (no working remedy); and national border/document scrutiny — sex-discrepancy visa refusals, passport processing blocks, foreign travel advisories — plus immigration-detention abuse documented for non-citizens. Mitigating: no presentation offence, no police targeting or organised violence recorded, functioning courts, national hate-crime and employment/housing coverage, full marriage recognition. No state violence statistics exist (thin, not reassuring). No service-discrimination-at-scale or extortion pattern that would push toward 0.35; exposures lack the pervasive targeting there. Sum of documented unremedied universal exposures keeps it below the 0.45 anchors' simpler single-exposure profiles.
